				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h1 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Husted bill to protect Americans from footing the bill for new data centers blocked from passage</h1>				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-334c7133 BodyContent elementor-widget elementor-widget-theme-post-content" data-id="334c7133" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="theme-post-content.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					
<p class="has-text-align-center"><em>“The Ratepayer Protection Act represents the most meaningful bipartisan step Congress could take to protect the American people from higher prices for electricity.”</em><br><br></p>



<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-large is-resized"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1024" height="569" src="https://www.husted.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Unknown-1024x569.png" alt="" class="wp-image-13115" style="width:623px;height:auto" srcset="https://www.husted.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Unknown-1024x569.png 1024w, https://www.husted.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Unknown-300x167.png 300w, https://www.husted.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Unknown-768x427.png 768w, https://www.husted.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Unknown.png 1122w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>



<p class="has-text-align-center">View Husted’s remarks <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zrRBVxlkLHI">here</a>.</p>



<p>WASHINGTON – Sen. Jon Husted (R-Ohio) today brought his Ratepayer Protection Act to the Senate floor, seeking its passage by unanimous consent—a process that expedites consideration of legislation in the United States Senate.</p>



<p>A Senate Democrat objected, blocking the bill from Senate passage.</p>



<p>The Ratepayer Protection Act would ensure American families and small businesses aren’t left paying for the energy infrastructure needed to support new data centers.</p>



<p>Husted introduced the <a href="https://www.husted.senate.gov/media/press-releases/husted-leads-bill-to-protect-americans-from-footing-the-bill-for-new-data-centers/">bill</a> on July 16, 2026. </p>



<p>The Ratepayer Protection Act passed the U.S. House of Representatives on Sept. 16, 2026, by an overwhelming, bipartisan vote of 417-3.</p>



<p><strong>Key excerpts include:</strong></p>



<p>“Mr. President, America is expected to build the equivalent of 1,000 major data centers during the next five years.</p>



<p>“You heard that correct.</p>



<p>“1,000 data centers within the next five years, with more than 2,000 projects currently being proposed.</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“And we need to protect American ratepayers from footing the bill.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“So, as we look to build the future, we must follow some basic principles of fairness.</p>



<p>“The company that is creating enormous new demands for electricity should pay the costs required to serve them.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“Working families, small businesses and senior citizens should not open up their electric bills and discover the pain for the power infrastructure needed by some large tech company in the world or in their neighborhood.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“That is the principle behind the Ratepayer Protection Act.</p>



<p>“When a very large electricity customer, such as the data center, connects to the grid, it can require investments in new generation transmission lines, substations and local distribution systems.</p>



<p>“The Ratepayer Protection Act would require state utility regulators to consider standards, ensuring that large load customers pay the full, incremental cost of the infrastructure needed to serve them.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“In plain language, if you create the cost, you should pay the cost.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“Data centers should only be located where communities want them.</p>



<p>“They can bring billions of dollars in private investment, construction work for electricians, pipefitters, equipment operators and other skilled trades, as well as revenue for schools and local services.</p>



<p>“But those benefits should not come with a hidden charge of electric bills for families, farmers and small businesses.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“When energy supply adequately meets demand, it helps put downward pressure on prices for consumers.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“Helps people save money.</p>



<p>“It’s what it does.</p>



<p>“They can keep more of their paycheck for what they need to spend on for their priorities.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“We can protect families and small businesses from unfair costs.</p>



<p>“The Ratepayer Protection Act rests on a principle every American understands: pay your own way.</p>



<p>“This is how we make sure American families are not left footing the bill for energy infrastructure required by data centers.</p>



<p>“Most importantly, it will help the American people keep more of what they earn.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“Yesterday, this bill passed the House of Representatives by a nearly unanimous vote of 417 to 3.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“So, the members of the House, they did their jobs.</p>



<p>“They stood up for the American ratepayer.</p>



<p>“And it’s time for the Senate to do the same.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“In a few moments, I’m going to ask my colleagues in the Senate to support the Ratepayer Protection Act.</p>



<p>“Together, we can send this bill to the president’s desk for his signature.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“The Ratepayer Protection Act represents the most meaningful bipartisan step Congress could take to protect the American people from higher prices for electricity.</p>



<p>“And I’m here today because we can get this done.”</p>



<p>. . .</p>



<p>“I am proud to have led this effort in the United States Senate.</p>



<p>“And I’m going to urge unanimous consent for this commonsense bill.”</p>



<p>View Husted’s full remarks <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zrRBVxlkLHI">here</a>. </p>

    if (hasSubmenuClass && hasSubMenuSibling) {

  setTimeout(() => {

  }, 100);
  
  //console.log("✅ Accordion initialization completed successfully!");

// Function to set up mutation observers for main menu items
function setupMainMenuObservers() {
  const mainMenuItems = $(".elementor-nav-menu--main .elementor-item");
  //console.log("? Found", mainMenuItems.length, "main menu items for observers");

  // Create a MutationObserver for each main menu item's parent
  mainMenuItems.each(function (index) {
    const mainMenuItem = $(this);
    const menuItemParent = mainMenuItem.closest(".menu-item");
    
    //console.log("? Setting up observer for main menu item", index + 1, ":", mainMenuItem.text().trim());

    if (menuItemParent.length) {
      // Add a small delay to prevent first-hover conflicts
      let hoverTimeout;
      
      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
          // Clear any existing timeout
          clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
          
          // Add a small delay to let Elementor finish its hover logic
          hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            // Check if any hover-related classes were removed
            if (!menuItemParent.hasClass("elementor-item-hover") && 
                !menuItemParent.hasClass("hover") &&
                !mainMenuItem.is(":hover")) {
              //console.log("? Hover ended on:", mainMenuItem.text().trim());
              closeAccordions(); // Close all nested accordions
            }
          }, 50); // Small delay to avoid conflicts with Elementor
        });
      });

      // Configure the MutationObserver to watch for attribute and class list changes
      const observerConfig = { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] };

      // Start observing the parent element
      observer.observe(menuItemParent[0], observerConfig);
      //console.log("? Observer started for:", mainMenuItem.text().trim());
    }
  });

  // Handle mouse leave events on the main navigation to close accordions
  $(".elementor-nav-menu__container").on("mouseleave", function() {
    //console.log("? Mouse left navigation container");
    closeAccordions();
  });

function initializeWithRetries(maxRetries = 5, delay = 500) {
  let attempts = 0;
  
  function tryInitialize() {
    attempts++;
    //console.log(`? Initialization attempt ${attempts}/${maxRetries}`);
    
    if (initializeAccordion()) {
      //console.log("? Accordion successfully initialized!");
      return;
    }
    
    if (attempts < maxRetries) {
      //console.log(`⏳ Retrying in ${delay}ms...`);
      setTimeout(tryInitialize, delay);
    } else {
      //console.error("❌ Failed to initialize accordion after", maxRetries, "attempts");
    }
  }
  
  tryInitialize();
}

// Function to close all nested accordions except the one being clicked
function closeAccordions(exceptItem = null) {
  //console.log("? closeAccordions() called");
  // Only target items that are inside a .sub-menu (nested items)
  const menuItems = $(".elementor-nav-menu--main .sub-menu .elementor-sub-item.has-submenu");
  //console.log("? Found", menuItems.length, "nested menu items to close");

    if (exceptItem && $item.is(exceptItem)) {
      //console.log("⏭️ Skipping current item:", $item.text().trim());
      return;
    }
    
    const wasActive = $item.hasClass("active");
    
    $item.removeClass("active");
    const submenu = $item.next(".sub-menu");
    if (submenu.length) {
      submenu.removeClass("show-submenu").hide();
      submenu.css({
        'visibility': 'hidden !important',
        'height': '0px !important',
        'max-height': '0px !important',
      });

      submenu[0].style.setProperty('visibility', 'hidden', 'important');
      submenu[0].style.setProperty('height', '0px', 'important');
      submenu[0].style.setProperty('max-height', '0px', 'important');
    }

    // Reset isExpanded to false by updating the data-is-expanded attribute

    if (wasActive) {
      //console.log("❌ Closed nested accordion for:", $item.text().trim());
    }
  });
}
